name: vishal-ml
description: Machine-learning tooling for Claude Code — fine-tune a small language model about any subject, on Apple Silicon, with an evaluation you can trust.

plugins.name: finetune-slm
plugins.description: Fine-tune a small language model to answer questions about a specific subject — a person, product, codebase, or any bounded domain. Drives the whole arc: deciding whether fine-tuning is even the right tool, curating facts, generating a paraphrase-augmented dataset, LoRA training with MLX on Apple Silicon, and building an evaluation that is not rigged in the model's favour. Carries the traps that cost a full night to find.
